enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Elf Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Elves, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.
Proficiency: Khopesh: While equipped this item grants the wielder all required knowledge to wield a Khopesh without proficiency penalties.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
